invariants.description: No executor may start without a valid execution brief.
No mutation may occur without an active scoped write lease.
No action may consume stale or invalidated input artifacts.
No executor may review or approve its own output.
No result is merge-eligible without all required verifiers.
No action may exceed its declared path or operation scope.
No remediation mutation may start without a failure classification.
No human gate, human merge, or A4 stop may be bypassed.
No action is complete without a valid typed artifact and receipt.
No campaign may execute with a failed IDE adapter conformance check.
